gloss: to settle down to, to commit seriously

definitions.gloss: to settle down, to commit seriously to a task
definitions.explanation: To approach something with serious, sustained effort; to buckle down and work diligently.

definitions.gloss: to settle in a place, to stay put
definitions.explanation: To establish oneself in a location for a considerable time.

examples.english: Let's buckle down and do this.

examples.japanese: {腰|こし}を{据|す}えて{勉強|べんきょう}する{時間|じかん}が{必要|ひつよう}だ。
examples.english: I need time to buckle down and study seriously.

examples.japanese: この{問題|もんだい}には{腰|こし}を{据|す}えて{取|と}り{組|く}むべきだ。
examples.english: We should tackle this problem with serious commitment.

examples.japanese: {転職|てんしょく}ばかりしていないで、そろそろ{腰|こし}を{据|す}えて{一|ひと}つの{会社|かいしゃ}で{頑張|がんば}ったらどうだ。
examples.english: Instead of constantly changing jobs, why don't you settle down and work hard at one company?

examples.japanese: {今度|こんど}こそ{腰|こし}を{据|す}えて、{最後|さいご}まで{諦|あきら}めずにやり{遂|と}げたい。
examples.english: This time I want to buckle down and see it through to the end without giving up.

examples.japanese: {京都|きょうと}に{腰|こし}を{据|す}えて{研究|けんきゅう}する。
examples.english: To settle in Kyoto and conduct research.

examples.japanese: やっと{腰|こし}を{据|す}える{場所|ばしょ}が{見|み}つかった。
examples.english: I finally found a place to settle down.

examples.japanese: {海外|かいがい}を{転々|てんてん}としていたが、{地元|じもと}に{腰|こし}を{据|す}えることにした。
examples.english: I had been moving around overseas, but decided to settle down in my hometown.

examples.japanese: {子供|こども}が{生|う}まれたので、{引|ひ}っ{越|こ}しをやめて{今|いま}の{町|まち}に{腰|こし}を{据|す}えることにした。
examples.english: Since we had a baby, we decided to stop moving and settle down in our current town.

examples.japanese: {十年|じゅうねん}{以上|いじょう}この{土地|とち}に{腰|こし}を{据|す}えて{暮|く}らしてきた。もう{他|ほか}の{場所|ばしょ}には{住|す}めない。
examples.english: I've been settled in this area for over ten years. I couldn't live anywhere else now.

notes:
STRUCTURE: {腰|こし} (waist/hip) + を + {据|す}える (to set, place firmly). Literally 'to set one's hips down' - the image of sitting down firmly to work.

NUANCE: Implies sustained, serious effort rather than casual or superficial engagement. Suggests patience and dedication.

CONTRAST WITH OTHER {腰|こし} EXPRESSIONS:
- {腰|こし}を{据|す}える: to commit, settle down
- {腰|こし}が{重|おも}い: slow to act, reluctant to start
- {腰|こし}が{低|ひく}い: humble in manner
- {腰|こし}が{軽|かる}い: quick to act, easy-going

RELATED EXPRESSIONS:
- じっくり{取|と}り{組|く}む (to work on carefully)
- {本腰|ほんごし}を{入|い}れる (to put serious effort into)
- {腰|こし}を{落|お}ち{着|つ}ける (to settle down)
